commentary: ConsensusBayes(C01+C04+C13) sleeve change produced IDENTICAL top-30 holdings as STR_1375(raw SUE). Jaccard=1.0. Score drop 76.6→57.4 from weight changes only. BayesShrinkage 3F in 5-sleeve score-blend = marginal information zero. C04/C13 signal absorbed by other 4 sleeves.
lesson: L-557: 5-sleeve score-blend에서 단일 sleeve 방법론 교체(EW→BayesShrinkage)는 최종 종목에 영향 없음. 4개 다른 슬리브의 score 합산이 지배. sleeve-level 차별화를 위해서는 완전히 다른 factor family 교체만 유효.
recommended_action: STR_1412 폐기. STR_1375 유지. Consensus sleeve 개선은 factor family 교체(e.g., crowding CR08)로만 시도.
